intended_use: Same existing code task/PR only. Diagnostic fixture, not a product implementation or extraction result.
fiction_notice: All sentences, compounds, model labels and experiment descriptions were newly composed. No paper, real molecule/model name, original stimulus identity, source quote, identifier, scientific measurement or database row is included. ATP and endpoint terms are generic ontology vocabulary.

issue_scope.confirmed: The inspected result evidence fragment contains a contextual term; the current structured source_context is null. Generic alias/action/total-endpoint order and a coordinated model construction were checked without exporting source text.
issue_scope.not_yet_established: Exact modifier attachment to each coordinated real model arm was NOT fully verified before the Mac became unreachable. Therefore NULL has not been conclusively adjudicated as a product error for every arm. Do not force-fill it based only on the previous posthoc stress-context label.
distinctions: Local source_context is distinct from a causal stimulus_agent; an explicitly anchored context can be supported while the agent remains unknown.
TOTAL/component endpoint scope and context/model-arm scope are separate constraints; satisfying one does not establish the other.
issue_scope.earlier_grammar_probe_correction: A naive punctuation split incorrectly counted decimal points as sentence boundaries. That count is invalid and supplies no evidence of cross-sentence context. No claim about actual sentence count is made.
issue_scope.coverage_limit: These are hypothetical minimal acceptance cases, not proof of coverage of the real source and not a blind/frozen scientific gold set. No source-code root-cause analysis was performed.

anchor_contract.offset_unit: Zero-based Unicode character offsets; end exclusive within each exact synthetic text.
anchor_contract.required: Every supported field must carry a local span and an unambiguous link to its molecule/model/result arm. A span occurring elsewhere in a paragraph is insufficient.
anchor_contract.context: Allow adjective modifiers inside a model noun phrase; do not require under/during/conditions keywords. Preserve only the explicitly evidenced contextual meaning.
anchor_contract.unknown: Null value, unknown status and no anchors whenever absent or ambiguous. No paragraph-level, cross-sentence, cross-arm or causal-agent completion without an explicit binding chain.
anchor_contract.coordination: Model modifiers are arm-local by default. Share only when the full grammatical scope is explicitly established; otherwise retain unknown for the ambiguous arm.
anchor_contract.migration: No SQL backfill, existing expectation modification, product execution, CLI rerun or installation change is requested by this fixture.
